items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: you get your perception of what it sounded like with Joe Turner and then what it sounded like later.

ctx.x: Yeah, so when you watch videos of people doing the Lindy hop at the Savoy there’s really not that much difference from what Bill Haley’s that swing, western swing feel was happening.

Absolutely. I agree. And that’s — I particularly noticed it when they played “Shake, Rattle & Roll” because you get your perception of what it sounded like with Joe Turner and then what it sounded like later. And this was down another path. This really was western swing which of course Joe Turner wasn’t. Joe was R&B and the western swing feel is different from the R&B feel. So it was very interesting to get that and to play with it. Marvelous.
When you get up from this session, will music — a musical task come back into your head?
